public.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
public.description: Process a fresh prefix tree through operations. Each operation is ["insert",word], ["search",word], or ["startsWith",prefix]. Return one output per operation: null for insert, exact membership for search, and whether any stored word begins with the prefix for startsWith. Strings contain 1 to 40 lowercase English letters, with 0 to 500 operations. Duplicate inserts have no extra effect. There is no constructor operation; every call starts empty.
hints: Separate complete-word markers from traversable prefixes.
A prefix can exist without being an inserted word.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Walk or create character edges and mark word endings. Queries distinguish path existence from terminal membership. O(total characters) time and space.
